attributes.description: Inventory Shadow AI tools on Linux endpoints — local LLMs, AI coding agents, AI desktop applications, MCP servers (MCP config file presence, metadata only), AI model files, Python/npm AI packages, browser extensions, Docker containers, systemd services, crontab entries, AI API key exposure, and AI tool configuration directories, vector databases, model cache sizes, and SSH tunnels for AI services.
attributes.name: ai-asset-discovery-linux

queries.query:
SELECT
    name,
    path,
    cmdline,
    pid,
    username,
    resident_size,
    start_time,
    ppid,
    category
FROM (
    SELECT
        p.name,
        p.path,
        p.cmdline,
        p.pid,
        u.username,
        p.resident_size,
        datetime(p.start_time, 'unixepoch') AS start_time,
        p.parent AS ppid,
        CASE
            WHEN (p.cmdline LIKE '%@modelcontextprotocol/%'
    OR p.cmdline LIKE '%mcp-server-%'
    OR p.cmdline LIKE '%mcp_server%'
    OR p.cmdline LIKE '%fastmcp%'

    OR LOWER(p.name) IN('github-mcp-server', 'mcp-server-github')) THEN 'mcp'

    OR p.cmdline LIKE '%codewhisperer%'
    OR p.cmdline LIKE '%AmazonWebServices.amazon-q%'
    OR p.cmdline LIKE '%sourcegraph.cody%'
    OR p.cmdline LIKE '%tabnine%'
    OR p.cmdline LIKE '%dev.warp.Warp%'
    OR p.cmdline LIKE '%dev.zed.Zed%'
    OR p.cmdline LIKE '%shell_gpt%'
    OR p.cmdline LIKE '%shell-gpt%'
    OR p.cmdline LIKE '%openhands%'
    OR p.cmdline LIKE '%swe-agent%'
    OR p.cmdline LIKE '%pieces-os%'
    OR p.cmdline LIKE '%supermaven%'
    OR p.cmdline LIKE '%augment%code%'
    OR p.cmdline LIKE '%openai/codex%'
    OR p.cmdline LIKE '%goose%session%'

    OR p.cmdline LIKE '%openclaw%'
    OR p.cmdline LIKE '%moltbot%'
    OR p.cmdline LIKE '%clawdbot%'
    OR p.cmdline LIKE '%autogpt%'
    OR p.cmdline LIKE '%auto-gpt%'

    OR p.cmdline LIKE '%agentgpt%'
    OR p.cmdline LIKE '%crewai%'

    OR p.cmdline LIKE '%semantic_kernel%'
    OR p.cmdline LIKE '%llama-index%'
    OR p.cmdline LIKE '%llama_index%'

    OR p.cmdline LIKE '%vscodium%'
    OR p.cmdline LIKE '%kiro%'
    OR p.cmdline LIKE '%cursor agent%'
    OR p.cmdline LIKE '%@cursor/agent%'
    OR p.cmdline LIKE '%cursor-cli%') THEN 'agent'
            WHEN (LOWER(p.name) IN('ollama', 'lms', 'gpt4all', 'jan', 'msty', 'local-ai', 'koboldcpp', 'llama-server', 'llama-cli', 'vllm', 'mlc_llm', 'mlc_chat', 'anythingllm', 'anything-llm', 'litellm', 'open-webui', 'llamafile', 'text-generation-launcher', 'text-generation-router', 'comfyui', 'invokeai', 'exo', 'tabby', 'qwen', 'grok')

    OR p.cmdline LIKE '%mlc_llm%'
    OR p.cmdline LIKE '%litellm%'
    OR p.cmdline LIKE '%open-webui%'
    OR p.cmdline LIKE '%anythingllm%'
    OR p.cmdline LIKE '%localai%'
    OR p.cmdline LIKE '%text-generation-webui%'
    OR p.cmdline LIKE '%oobabooga%'
    OR p.cmdline LIKE '%comfyui%'
    OR p.cmdline LIKE '%invokeai%'
    OR p.cmdline LIKE '%stable-diffusion-webui%'
    OR p.cmdline LIKE '%whisper%server%'
    OR p.cmdline LIKE '%msty%serve%'
    OR p.cmdline LIKE '%tabby%serve%'
    OR p.cmdline LIKE '%exo serve%'
    OR p.cmdline LIKE '%exo-launcher%'

    OR p.cmdline LIKE '%cohere serve%'
    OR p.cmdline LIKE '%mistral serve%') THEN 'llm_runtime'
        END AS category
    FROM processes p
    LEFT JOIN users u ON p.uid = u.uid
) AS ai_procs
WHERE category IS NOT NULL;

SELECT
    path,
    size,
    type,
    username,
    modified_time,
    accessed_time,
    config_kind
FROM (
    SELECT
        f.path,
        f.size,
        f.type,
        u.username,
        datetime(f.mtime, 'unixepoch') AS modified_time,
        datetime(f.atime, 'unixepoch') AS accessed_time,
        CASE
            WHEN (f.path LIKE '/home/%/.config/Claude/claude_desktop_config.json'
    OR f.path LIKE '/home/%/.claude.json'
    OR f.path LIKE '/home/%/.claude/settings.json'
    OR f.path LIKE '/home/%/.cursor/mcp.json'
    OR f.path LIKE '/home/%/.vscode/mcp.json'
    OR f.path LIKE '/home/%/.mcp.json'
OR f.path LIKE '/home/%/.kiro/settings/mcp.json'
    OR f.path LIKE '/home/%/.codeium/windsurf/mcp_config.json'
    OR f.path LIKE '/home/%/.gemini/settings.json'
    OR f.path LIKE '/home/%/.codex/config.toml'
    OR f.path LIKE '/home/%/.config/opencode/opencode.json'

    OR f.path LIKE '/home/%/Documents/%/.mcp.json'
    OR f.path LIKE '/home/%/projects/%/.mcp.json'
    OR f.path LIKE '/home/%/dev/%/.mcp.json'
    OR f.path LIKE '/home/%/src/%/.mcp.json'
    OR f.path LIKE '/home/%/repos/%/.mcp.json'
    OR f.path LIKE '/home/%/code/%/.mcp.json'
    OR f.path LIKE '/home/%/Documents/%/.vscode/mcp.json'
    OR f.path LIKE '/home/%/projects/%/.vscode/mcp.json'
    OR f.path LIKE '/home/%/dev/%/.vscode/mcp.json'
    OR f.path LIKE '/home/%/src/%/.vscode/mcp.json'
    OR f.path LIKE '/home/%/repos/%/.vscode/mcp.json'
    OR f.path LIKE '/home/%/code/%/.vscode/mcp.json') THEN 'mcp_config'
            WHEN ((f.type = 'directory' AND (f.path LIKE '/home/%/.ollama'
    OR f.path LIKE '/home/%/.cursor'
    OR f.path LIKE '/home/%/.claude'
    OR f.path LIKE '/home/%/.continue'
    OR f.path LIKE '/home/%/.codeium'
    OR f.path LIKE '/home/%/.tabnine'
    OR f.path LIKE '/home/%/.supermaven'
    OR f.path LIKE '/home/%/.anythingllm'
    OR f.path LIKE '/home/%/.invokeai'
    OR f.path LIKE '/home/%/jan'
    OR f.path LIKE '/home/%/.cache/lm-studio'
    OR f.path LIKE '/home/%/.cache/huggingface'
    OR f.path LIKE '/home/%/.cache/gpt4all'
    OR f.path LIKE '/home/%/.cache/llama.cpp'
    OR f.path LIKE '/home/%/.config/github-copilot'
    OR f.path LIKE '/home/%/.config/shell_gpt'
    OR f.path LIKE '/home/%/.gemini'
    OR f.path LIKE '/home/%/.codex'
    OR f.path LIKE '/home/%/.kiro'
    OR f.path LIKE '/home/%/.config/opencode'
    OR f.path LIKE '/home/%/.openclaw'
    OR f.path LIKE '/home/%/.lmstudio'
    OR f.path LIKE '/home/%/.hermes'
    OR f.path LIKE '/home/%/.kilocode'
    OR f.path LIKE '/home/%/.cursor/skills'
    OR f.path LIKE '/home/%/.cursor/skills-cursor'
    OR f.path LIKE '/home/%/.cursor/plugins'
    OR f.path LIKE '/home/%/.cursor/hooks'
    OR f.path LIKE '/home/%/.claude/skills'
    OR f.path LIKE '/home/%/.claude/plugins'
    OR f.path LIKE '/home/%/.claude/hooks'
    OR f.path LIKE '/home/%/.codex/skills'
    OR f.path LIKE '/home/%/.openclaw/skills'
    OR f.path LIKE '/home/%/.openclaw/hooks'
    OR f.path LIKE '/home/%/.kilocode/skills'
    OR f.path LIKE '/home/%/.continue/skills'))) THEN 'tool_directory'
            WHEN (f.path LIKE '/home/%/.aider.conf.yml') THEN 'tool_config'
        END AS config_kind
    FROM file f
    LEFT JOIN users u ON f.uid = u.uid
) AS ai_config
WHERE config_kind IS NOT NULL;

SELECT
    path,
    filename,
    size,
    datetime(mtime, 'unixepoch') AS modified_time,
    datetime(atime, 'unixepoch') AS accessed_time,
    CASE
        WHEN path LIKE '/home/%/.ollama/models/%' THEN 'ollama'
        WHEN path LIKE '/home/%/.lmstudio/%' OR path LIKE '/home/%/.cache/lm-studio/%' THEN 'lm-studio'
        WHEN path LIKE '/home/%/.cache/huggingface/%' THEN 'huggingface'
        WHEN path LIKE '/home/%/.cache/llama.cpp/%' THEN 'llama.cpp'
        WHEN path LIKE '/home/%/.local/share/nomic.ai/GPT4All/%' THEN 'gpt4all'
        WHEN path LIKE '/home/%/Downloads/%' THEN 'download'
        WHEN path LIKE '/opt/models/%' THEN 'other'
        ELSE 'other'
    END AS tool
FROM file
WHERE (
    path LIKE '/home/%/.ollama/models/blobs/%'
    OR path LIKE '/home/%/.ollama/models/%/%'
    OR path LIKE '/home/%/.lmstudio/models/%'
    OR path LIKE '/home/%/.cache/lm-studio/%'
    OR path LIKE '/home/%/.cache/huggingface/hub/%'
    OR path LIKE '/home/%/.cache/huggingface/hub/%.safetensors'
    OR path LIKE '/home/%/.cache/huggingface/hub/%.gguf'
    OR path LIKE '/home/%/.cache/llama.cpp/%'
    OR path LIKE '/home/%/.cache/llama.cpp/%.gguf'
    OR path LIKE '/home/%/.local/share/nomic.ai/GPT4All/%'
    OR path LIKE '/home/%/.local/share/nomic.ai/GPT4All/%.gguf'
    OR path LIKE '/home/%/Downloads/%.gguf'
    OR path LIKE '/home/%/Downloads/%.safetensors'
    OR path LIKE '/home/%/Downloads/%.llamafile'
    OR path LIKE '/home/%/Downloads/%.ggml'
    OR path LIKE '/home/%/Downloads/%.onnx'
    OR path LIKE '/opt/models/%'
)
AND size > 104857600;

SELECT
    ce.name,
    ce.identifier,
    ce.version,
    ce.description,
    ce.path,
    ce.state,
    u.username,
    CASE
        WHEN ce.name LIKE '%GitHub Copilot%' OR ce.identifier LIKE '%github%copilot%' THEN 'developer'
        WHEN ce.name LIKE '%Microsoft%Copilot%' OR ce.identifier LIKE '%microsoft%copilot%' THEN 'productivity'

    ce.name LIKE '%Copilot%' OR ce.name LIKE '%ChatGPT%'

SELECT

    p.path AS process_path,

    u.username,
    sens.path AS sensitive_file_path,
    sens.size AS sensitive_file_size,
    datetime(sens.atime, 'unixepoch') AS accessed_time,
    datetime(sens.mtime, 'unixepoch') AS modified_time,
    ai.process_category
FROM processes p
JOIN users u ON p.uid = u.uid
JOIN (
    SELECT
        p.pid,
        CASE
            WHEN (p.cmdline LIKE '%@modelcontextprotocol/%'
    OR p.cmdline LIKE '%mcp-server-%'
    OR p.cmdline LIKE '%mcp_server%'

    OR p.cmdline LIKE '%Windsurf%'
    OR p.cmdline LIKE '%codeium_language_server%'

    OR p.cmdline LIKE '%tabnine%'

    OR p.cmdline LIKE '%dev.zed.Zed%'

    OR p.cmdline LIKE '%shell-gpt%'
    OR p.cmdline LIKE '%openhands%'
    OR p.cmdline LIKE '%swe-agent%'
    OR p.cmdline LIKE '%pieces-os%'
    OR p.cmdline LIKE '%supermaven%'
    OR p.cmdline LIKE '%augment%code%'

    OR p.cmdline LIKE '%goose%session%'

    OR p.cmdline LIKE '%openclaw%'
    OR p.cmdline LIKE '%moltbot%'
    OR p.cmdline LIKE '%clawdbot%'

    OR p.cmdline LIKE '%auto-gpt%'

    OR p.cmdline LIKE '%semantic_kernel%'

    OR p.cmdline LIKE '%llama_index%'
    
    OR p.cmdline LIKE '%opencode%'

    OR p.cmdline LIKE '%kiro%'
    OR p.cmdline LIKE '%cursor agent%'
    OR p.cmdline LIKE '%@cursor/agent%'
    OR p.cmdline LIKE '%cursor-cli%') THEN 'agent'
            WHEN (LOWER(p.name) IN('ollama', 'lms', 'gpt4all', 'jan', 'msty', 'local-ai', 'koboldcpp', 'llama-server', 'llama-cli', 'vllm', 'mlc_llm', 'mlc_chat', 'anythingllm', 'anything-llm', 'litellm', 'open-webui', 'llamafile', 'text-generation-launcher', 'text-generation-router', 'comfyui', 'invokeai', 'exo', 'tabby', 'qwen', 'grok')
    OR p.cmdline LIKE '%ollama serve%'
    OR p.cmdline LIKE '%vllm.entrypoints%'
    OR p.cmdline LIKE '%text-generation-launcher%'
    OR p.cmdline LIKE '%koboldcpp%'
    OR p.cmdline LIKE '%llama-server%'
    OR p.cmdline LIKE '%llama.cpp%server%'
    OR p.cmdline LIKE '%llamafile%'
    OR p.cmdline LIKE '%mlc_llm%'
    OR p.cmdline LIKE '%litellm%'
    OR p.cmdline LIKE '%open-webui%'
    OR p.cmdline LIKE '%anythingllm%'
    OR p.cmdline LIKE '%localai%'
    OR p.cmdline LIKE '%text-generation-webui%'
    OR p.cmdline LIKE '%oobabooga%'
    OR p.cmdline LIKE '%comfyui%'
    OR p.cmdline LIKE '%invokeai%'
    OR p.cmdline LIKE '%stable-diffusion-webui%'
    OR p.cmdline LIKE '%whisper%server%'
    OR p.cmdline LIKE '%msty%serve%'
    OR p.cmdline LIKE '%tabby%serve%'
    OR p.cmdline LIKE '%exo serve%'
    OR p.cmdline LIKE '%exo-launcher%'

    OR p.cmdline LIKE '%cohere serve%'
    OR p.cmdline LIKE '%mistral serve%') THEN 'llm_runtime'
        END AS process_category
    FROM processes p
) ai ON ai.pid = p.pid AND ai.process_category IS NOT NULL
JOIN (
    SELECT path, size, atime, mtime, uid
    FROM file
    WHERE path LIKE '/home/%/.aws/credentials'
        OR path LIKE '/home/%/.aws/config'
        OR path LIKE '/home/%/.ssh/id_rsa'
        OR path LIKE '/home/%/.ssh/id_ed25519'
        OR path LIKE '/home/%/.ssh/id_ecdsa'
        OR path LIKE '/home/%/.config/gcloud/credentials.db'
        OR path LIKE '/home/%/.config/gcloud/application_default_credentials.json'
        OR path LIKE '/home/%/.azure/accessTokens.json'
        OR path LIKE '/home/%/.azure/msal_token_cache.json'
) AS sens ON p.uid = sens.uid
JOIN process_open_files pof ON pof.pid = p.pid AND pof.path = sens.path;

SELECT
    p.name AS process_name,
    p.path AS process_path,
    p.cmdline,
    p.pid,
    u.username,
    pos.remote_address,
    pos.remote_port,
    pos.local_port,
    pos.local_address,
    pos.state,
    CASE pos.family
        WHEN 2 THEN 'IPv4'
        WHEN 10 THEN 'IPv6'
        ELSE 'unknown'
    END AS address_family,
    CASE pos.protocol
        WHEN 6 THEN 'tcp'
        WHEN 17 THEN 'udp'
        ELSE CAST(pos.protocol AS TEXT)
    END AS transport_protocol,
    CASE
        WHEN pos.remote_address LIKE '10.%'
            OR pos.remote_address LIKE '192.168.%'
            OR pos.remote_address LIKE '172.1[6-9].%'
            OR pos.remote_address LIKE '172.2[0-9].%'
            OR pos.remote_address LIKE '172.3[0-1].%'
            THEN 1
        ELSE 0
    END AS is_rfc1918_destination,
    ai.process_category,
    datetime(p.start_time, 'unixepoch') AS start_time
FROM (
    SELECT *
    FROM process_open_sockets
    WHERE remote_address NOT IN ('127.0.0.1', '::1', '0.0.0.0', '::')
        AND remote_address != ''
        AND (state IN ('ESTABLISHED', 'CLOSE_WAIT', 'SYN_SENT') OR state IS NULL)
) pos
JOIN processes p ON pos.pid = p.pid
LEFT JOIN users u ON p.uid = u.uid

    OR p.cmdline LIKE '%codeium%enterprise%'

    OR p.cmdline LIKE '%aider-chat%'
    OR p.cmdline LIKE '%aider%--model%'
    OR p.cmdline LIKE '%saoudrizwan.claude-dev%'
    OR p.cmdline LIKE '%rooveterinaryinc.roo-cline%'
    OR p.cmdline LIKE '%continue.continue%'
    OR p.cmdline LIKE '%continuedev%'
    OR p.cmdline LIKE '%amazon-q%'
    OR p.cmdline LIKE '%codewhisperer%'
    OR p.cmdline LIKE '%AmazonWebServices.amazon-q%'
    OR p.cmdline LIKE '%sourcegraph.cody%'
    OR p.cmdline LIKE '%tabnine%'
    OR p.cmdline LIKE '%dev.warp.Warp%'
    OR p.cmdline LIKE '%dev.zed.Zed%'
    OR p.cmdline LIKE '%shell_gpt%'
    OR p.cmdline LIKE '%shell-gpt%'
    OR p.cmdline LIKE '%openhands%'
    OR p.cmdline LIKE '%swe-agent%'
    OR p.cmdline LIKE '%pieces-os%'
    OR p.cmdline LIKE '%supermaven%'
    OR p.cmdline LIKE '%augment%code%'
    OR p.cmdline LIKE '%openai/codex%'
    OR p.cmdline LIKE '%goose%session%'

    OR p.cmdline LIKE '%openclaw%'
    OR p.cmdline LIKE '%moltbot%'
    OR p.cmdline LIKE '%clawdbot%'
    OR p.cmdline LIKE '%autogpt%'
    OR p.cmdline LIKE '%auto-gpt%'
    OR p.cmdline LIKE '%babyagi%'
    OR p.cmdline LIKE '%agentgpt%'
    OR p.cmdline LIKE '%crewai%'
    OR p.cmdline LIKE '%semantic-kernel%'
    OR p.cmdline LIKE '%semantic_kernel%'
    OR p.cmdline LIKE '%llama-index%'
    OR p.cmdline LIKE '%llama_index%'
    
    OR p.cmdline LIKE '%opencode%'
    OR p.cmdline LIKE '%kilocode%'
    OR p.cmdline LIKE '%vscodium%'
    OR p.cmdline LIKE '%kiro%'
    OR p.cmdline LIKE '%cursor agent%'
    OR p.cmdline LIKE '%@cursor/agent%'
    OR p.cmdline LIKE '%cursor-cli%') THEN 'agent'
            WHEN (LOWER(p.name) IN('ollama', 'lms', 'gpt4all', 'jan', 'msty', 'local-ai', 'koboldcpp', 'llama-server', 'llama-cli', 'vllm', 'mlc_llm', 'mlc_chat', 'anythingllm', 'anything-llm', 'litellm', 'open-webui', 'llamafile', 'text-generation-launcher', 'text-generation-router', 'comfyui', 'invokeai', 'exo', 'tabby', 'qwen', 'grok')
    OR p.cmdline LIKE '%ollama serve%'
    OR p.cmdline LIKE '%vllm.entrypoints%'
    OR p.cmdline LIKE '%text-generation-launcher%'
    OR p.cmdline LIKE '%koboldcpp%'
    OR p.cmdline LIKE '%llama-server%'
    OR p.cmdline LIKE '%llama.cpp%server%'
    OR p.cmdline LIKE '%llamafile%'
    OR p.cmdline LIKE '%mlc_llm%'
    OR p.cmdline LIKE '%litellm%'
    OR p.cmdline LIKE '%open-webui%'
    OR p.cmdline LIKE '%anythingllm%'
    OR p.cmdline LIKE '%localai%'
    OR p.cmdline LIKE '%text-generation-webui%'
    OR p.cmdline LIKE '%oobabooga%'
    OR p.cmdline LIKE '%comfyui%'
    OR p.cmdline LIKE '%invokeai%'
    OR p.cmdline LIKE '%stable-diffusion-webui%'
    OR p.cmdline LIKE '%whisper%server%'
    OR p.cmdline LIKE '%msty%serve%'
    OR p.cmdline LIKE '%tabby%serve%'
    OR p.cmdline LIKE '%exo serve%'
    OR p.cmdline LIKE '%exo-launcher%'

    OR p.cmdline LIKE '%cohere serve%'
    OR p.cmdline LIKE '%mistral serve%') THEN 'llm_runtime'
        END AS process_category
    FROM processes p
) ai ON ai.pid = p.pid AND ai.process_category IS NOT NULL;
